edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from
transfer passes msg.sender into transferFrom as the source address
transferFrom must satisfy ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving funds
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and consumes its allowance
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping of _from/msg.sender
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value
transferFrom executes unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value
unchecked subtraction mutates balanceOf[_from] and can underflow
unchecked addition mutates balanceOf[_to] and can overflow
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address for address(this)
ensure requires condition(_from,_value) to hold for non-whitelisted senders
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping for _from
ensure compares _from and _to against owner to bypass restrictions
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress to bypass restrictions
ensure compares _from against the UNI router constant
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum
condition rejects transfers below _minSale
condition rejects transfers above _maxSale
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
approve grants allowance on behalf of msg.sender without restriction
